description: This file is a CMake configuration script for locating and configuring the TTS (Text-to-Speech) library and its dependencies, setting up cache variables and including necessary paths and libraries.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for and loads a package configuration for a given package.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library and sets the variable with its path.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the directory containing certain files.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a variable to a specified value, often with cache options.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks certain variables as advanced, hiding them from default CMake interface.

calls: set(TTS_INCLUDE_DIRS ${TTS_INCLUDE_DIRS} CACHE PATH "Path to TTS include")
set(TTSC_INCLUDE_DIRS ${TTSC_INCLUDE_DIRS} CACHE PATH "Path to TTSClient include")
